name: cancel_subscription
description:
Cancels a subscription in Strope.

This function cancels a subscription in Strope. It requires the ID of the
subscription to be canceled, which is passed as an argument.

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to cancel.

name: create_coupon
description:
This function creates a coupon in Strope. The discount can be specified either as a percentage off via `percent_off`

or as a fixed amount off via `amount_off`. It is essential that only one of these, `percent_off` or `amount_off`,
is used to define the discount; providing values for both, or values for neither
that define a valid discount, will result in an error. If `amount_off` is used as the discount method,
the `currency` parameter must also be appropriately set (it defaults to 'usd').
The function also supports optional parameters to define the coupon's duration. The `duration`
parameter specifies how long the discount remains active and accepts 'once', 'repeating', or 'forever'
(defaulting to 'once'). If `duration` is 'repeating', the `duration_in_months` parameter is
required to indicate the number of months the coupon applies.

name.description:
Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts.
By default the `id` is shown if `name` is not set. Must be a non-empty string with meaningful content. Defaults to None.

percent_off.description:
A positive float larger than 0 and smaller or equal to 100,
representing the percentage discount the coupon will apply. Values are rounded to 2 decimal places.
If provided, this defines the coupon's discount instead of `amount_off`. Defaults to None.

amount_off.description:
A positive integer representing the amount to subtract from an
invoice total. This parameter is required if `percent_off` is not provided. Defaults to None.

currency.description:
Three-letter ISO code for the currency of the `amount_off` parameter (e.g., 'usd', 'eur').
This is required if `amount_off` is used to specify the discount and `percent_off` is not provided. Defaults to 'usd'.

duration.description: Specifies how long the discount will last. Valid values are 'once', 'repeating', or 'forever'. Defaults to 'once'.

duration_in_months.description:
If `duration` is 'repeating', this specifies
the number of months the discount will apply. Defaults to None.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the metadata key-value pair.

name: create_customer
description: This tool creates a customer in Strope.

name: create_invoice
description:
This tool will create an invoice in Strope.

This tool creates an invoice in Strope. It takes the ID of the customer (`customer`) for whom to create the invoice, an optional number of days (`days_until_due`) until the invoice is due, and an optional three-letter ISO `currency` code (defaults to 'usd'). The invoice currency must match the currency of any prices later attached via create_invoice_item.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice for. Must start with 'cus_'.

days_until_due.description: The number of days until the invoice is due. Defaults to None.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (lowercase) for the invoice (e.g. 'usd', 'eur', 'gbp', 'jpy', 'cad', 'aud', 'nzd'). Defaults to 'usd'. Must match the currency of any prices added to this invoice via create_invoice_item.

name: create_invoice_item
description:
This tool will create an invoice item in Strope.

This function creates an invoice item in Strope. It uses the provided customer ID,
price ID, and invoice ID to define the new invoice item's associations and
link it to the respective customer, product/service price, and invoice.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice item for.

price.description: The ID of the price for the item.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to create the item for.

name: create_payment_intent
description:
Creates a PaymentIntent object in Strope.

This function creates a PaymentIntent object in Strope. A PaymentIntent guides you through the process of collecting a payment from your customer. You can reference the PaymentIntent later to see the history of payment attempts for a particular session.

amount.description: Amount intended to be collected by this PaymentIntent. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00). The minimum amount is $0.50 US or equivalent in charge currency.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code. Any case variation (e.g., USD, UsD, usd) is accepted and converted to lowercase. Must be a supported currency.

customer.description: ID of the Customer this PaymentIntent belongs to, if one exists. Defaults to None.

payment_method_types.description: The list of payment method types (e.g., card) that this PaymentIntent is allowed to use. Defaults to ["card"] if not provided.

capture_method.description: Controls when the funds will be captured from the customer's account. Must be one of: "automatic", "automatic_async", "manual". Defaults to "automatic_async".

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Defaults to empty dictionary {}.

name: create_payment_link
description:
Creates a payment link in Strope.

This function creates a payment link in Strope. It takes the ID of the price
to create the payment link for and the quantity of the product to include
in the payment link.

price.description: The ID of the price to create the payment link for.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product to include. Must be greater than 0.

name: create_price
description:
This tool will create a price in Strope.

This function creates a new price. If a product has not already been
specified, a product should be created first. It uses the provided product ID,
unit amount (in cents), and currency to define the new price.

product.description: The ID of the product to create the price for.

unit_amount.description: The unit amount of the price in cents. Non negative integer.

name: create_product
description:
This tool will create a product in Strope.

This function creates a product in Strope. It accepts a name for the product,
which is mandatory, and an optional description to further detail the product.

name.description: The name of the product, Minimum length is 1 character, Maximum length is 200 characters.

description.description: The description of the product. Defaults to None.

name: create_refund
description:
This tool will refund a payment intent in Strope.

It takes three arguments:
- payment_intent (str): The ID of the payment intent to refund.
- amount (int, optional): The amount to refund in cents. Defaults to None.
- reason (str, optional): The reason for the refund. Defaults to None.

payment_intent.description: The ID of the PaymentIntent to refund.

amount.description: The amount to refund in cents. Defaults to None.

reason.description: The reason for the refund. If provided, must be one of: "duplicate", "fraudulent", "requested_by_customer". Defaults to None.

name: delete_product
description:
This tool will delete a product from Strope.

This function deletes a product from Strope by its ID. The product will be permanently deleted
and cannot be recovered. The product cannot be deleted if it has associated with any of the following: price, subscription, invoice, payment link, invoice item objects.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to delete.

name: finalize_invoice
description:
This tool will finalize an invoice in Strope.

This function finalizes an invoice in Strope. It takes the ID of the invoice to finalize as an argument.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to finalize.

name: list_coupons
description:
This tool will fetch a list of Coupons from Strope.

This function fetches a list of Coupons from Strope. It takes one optional argument,
`limit`, which is an integer used to specify the number of coupons to return.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100. Defaults to None.

name: list_customers
description:
This function fetches a list of Customers from Strope. It processes an optional `limit`

to control the number of customers retrieved and an optional `email` to filter
customers by their email address in a case-sensitive manner.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10.

email.description: A case-sensitive filter on the list based on the customer's email field. The value must be a string. Defaults to None.

name: list_disputes
description:
This function fetches a list of disputes in Strope. It allows filtering the

disputes based on an associated charge ID or PaymentIntent ID, and limiting
the number of results.

charge.description:
Only return disputes associated to the charge
specified by this charge ID. Defaults to None.

payment_intent.description:
Only return disputes associated to the
PaymentIntent specified by this PaymentIntent ID. Defaults to None.

limit.description:
A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can
range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10. Defaults to 10.

name: list_invoices
description:
This tool will list all invoices in Strope.

This function lists all invoices in Strope. It allows for filtering the invoices based on customer, status, starting after, ending before, and limiting the number of results returned.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list invoices for. Defaults to None.

status.description: The status of the invoices to retrieve. If provided, must be one of the following: "draft", "open", "paid", "uncollectible", "void". Defaults to None.

starting_after.description: The ID of the invoice to start after. Defaults to None.

ending_before.description: The ID of the invoice to end before. Defaults to None.

limit.description: The maximum number of invoices to return. Defaults to 10. It can range between 1 and 100.

created.description: A dictionary with the following keys:

gte.description: Unix timestamp of the date on which the invoice was created. Defaults to None.

lte.description: Unix timestamp of the date on which the invoice was created. Defaults to None.

gt.description: Unix timestamp of the date on which the invoice was created. Defaults to None.

lt.description: Unix timestamp of the date on which the invoice was created. Defaults to None.

name: list_payment_intents
description:
This tool will list payment intents in Strope.

This function lists payment intents in Strope. It supports filtering by customer ID,
limiting the number of results, and pagination using cursor-based navigation.
You can filter payment intents by customer ID, specify a limit on the number of results
(defaults to 10 if not provided), and use starting_after or ending_before parameters
for pagination to navigate through large result sets.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list payment intents for. Defaults to None.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10 if not provided.

starting_after.description: A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. Defaults to None.

ending_before.description: A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. Defaults to None.

name: list_prices
description:
This tool will fetch a list of Prices from Strope.

This function fetches a list of Prices from Strope. It takes two optional arguments:
`product`, the ID of the product to list prices for, and `limit`, the number of prices to return.

product.description: The ID of the product to list prices for. Defaults to None.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10.

name: list_products
description:
"This tool will fetch a list of Products from Strope.

This tool fetches a list of Products from Strope. It takes two arguments, `limit` and `active`, to specify the number of products to return and whether to return only active products.
Results are sorted by the `created` timestamp in descending order (newest first).

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

active.description: Whether to return only active products. Defaults to True.

name: list_subscriptions
description:
This tool will list all subscriptions in Strope.

This function lists all subscriptions in Strope. It allows for filtering the
subscriptions based on customer ID, price ID, status, and limiting the
number of results returned.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list subscriptions for. Defaults to None.

price.description: The ID of the price to list subscriptions for. Defaults to None.

status.description:
The status of the subscriptions to retrieve. Possible
values: 'active', 'past_due', 'unpaid', 'canceled', 'incomplete',
'incomplete_expired', 'trialing', 'all'. Defaults to None.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100. Default is 10 if not provided.

name: retrieve_balance
description:
Retrieves the balance from Strope.

This function retrieves the balance from Strope. It takes no input.

name: update_dispute
description:
Updates a dispute, allowing for the submission of evidence to aid in its resolution.

This function is used to update a specific dispute. When a dispute is received, it is generally best to first contact the customer.
If this does not resolve the issue, this function allows for the submission of evidence to support your position in the dispute.
Evidence provided can be immediately submitted to the bank or staged on the dispute for later submission, based on the `submit` parameter.
Updating any field in the `evidence` hash will submit all fields in that hash for review.

dispute.description: The ID of the dispute to update.

evidence.description: Evidence to upload, to respond to a dispute. Defaults to None. If provided then it should be a dictionary with the following keys:

cancellation_policy_disclosure.description: An explanation of how and when the customer was shown your refund policy prior to purchase.

cancellation_rebuttal.description: A rebuttal to a cancellation claim provided.

duplicate_charge_explanation.description: An explanation of the difference between the disputed charge versus the prior charge that appears to be a duplicate.

submit.description: Whether to immediately submit evidence to the bank. If false, evidence is staged on the dispute. Defaults to False.

name: update_subscription
description:
This tool will update an existing subscription in Strope. You can add new items,
modify existing items directly by providing their 'id' along with new 'price' and/or 'quantity',
or delete items by setting 'deleted' to true.

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to update.

proration_behavior.description: Determines how to handle prorations when the subscription items change. Options: 'create_prorations', 'always_invoice', 'none_implicit', 'none'. Defaults to None.

items.description: A list of subscription items to update, add, or remove. Each item in the list is a dictionary that can contain the following keys:

id.description: The ID of the subscription item to modify. Required when deleting an existing item (deleted: true). Must be a non-empty string when provided. Should not be provided when adding a new item.

price.description: The ID of the price to switch to. Required when adding a new item (deleted: false or not provided). Should not be provided when deleting an existing item.

quantity.description: The quantity of the plan to subscribe to. Must be a positive integer (greater than 0). Required when adding a new item (deleted: false or not provided). Should not be provided when deleting an existing item.

deleted.description: Whether to delete this item. If true, only the id field is required. If false or not provided: when adding a new item (no id), both price and quantity are required; when modifying an existing item (with id), at least one of price or quantity is required.

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs that can be attached to the subscription item for storing additional information.

additionalProperties.description: The value for each metadata key-value pair.
